arStrings.szText: Your {c_important}Earth{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} bonus Critical Strike damage. This bonus is increased to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*2*100|x%|]{/c} with at least {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. You passively gain {c_number}2{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
